children: Disney's subscription video on demand business is prioritizing revenue after achieving sustainable profitability, Benchmark analyst Mike Hickey says. The media conglomerate had 13% margins for subscription video on demand in the fiscal third quarter, and management doesn't expect margins to retreat materially or fall below a double-digit percentage, Hickey says. "This represents an incremental shift from providing profitability toward reinvesting to accelerate growth," Hickey says. Life-sports advertising demand also remains strong, while AI, healthcare and political advertising business are performing well. (katherine.hamilton@wsj.com)
